title: SKE Crystal Strawberry Kiwi Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Strawberry Kiwi flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid is a perfectly balanced mix of the sweet taste of ripe strawberries and the tart zest of kiwi, creating a harmoniously refreshing vaping experience. This flavour is ideal for those who appreciate a sweet yet slightly tangy fruit profile in their vape. Part of the innovative SKE Crystal Nic Salts range, this e-liquid uses nicotine salts to provide a smooth vaping experience suitable for those transitioning from smoking. It’s also formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, which ensures a satisfactory balance between flavour capture and vapour production, compatible with most MTL vaping devices. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
